recommendations: Low-dose colchicine (0.5 mg once daily) may be considered, particularly if other risk factors are insufficiently controlled or if recurrent cardiovascular disease events occur under optimal therapy (Class IIb, Level A).
Increase statin potency/dose if on low-potency/low-dose statin; add ezetimibe if patient is on statins at highest tolerated dose; add PCSK9 inhibitor if the patient is on statins plus ezetimibe.
content.patient_perspectives_summary: Management of patients with ACS should combine best available clinical evidence with care respectful of patient preferences, needs and values. Patient-centred care guided by ethical values improves outcomes and engagement; education and involvement should be continuous across the patient journey from admission to discharge and rehabilitation.

genes.context: Listed in abbreviations as 'proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9)' and recommended as an add-on 'PCSK9 inhibitor' if the patient is on statins plus ezetimibe to further lower LDL-C in patients with ACS/cardiovascular disease.
